_note: Candidate registry for New Jersey 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (New Jersey Division of Elections, Official List: Candidates for House of Representatives, For GENERAL ELECTION 11/03/2026 (dated 09/04/2026); U.S. Senate from the Official List: Candidates for US Senate, For GENERAL ELECTION 11/03/2026 (dated 07/27/2026), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: New Jersey Division of Elections, Official List: Candidates for House of Representatives, For GENERAL ELECTION 11/03/2026 (dated 09/04/2026); U.S. Senate from the Official List: Candidates for US Senate, For GENERAL ELECTION 11/03/2026 (dated 07/27/2026) (https://www.nj.gov/state/elections/assets/pdf/election-results/2026/2026-official-general-candidates-us-house-0904.pdf); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
